text.p: These are the leading stories in the Tunisian press on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- President Ben Ali asks Prime Minister Hamed Karoui to open 7th meeting of youth and firms to be held on July 10-11 and which aims at reinforcing professional training partenership with firms.
- President receives report from Higher Education Minister Daly Jazi on the academic year and good results of final exams.
- Foreign Affairs Minister Abderrahim Zouari and visiting Iranian counterpart Ali Akbar Velayati chaired the first joint committee for talks on boosting economic and trade cooperation.
- Transport Minister Sadok Rabeh and his Italian counterpart Claudio Burlando on Monday held talks in Tunis on boosting cooperation in transport sector.
- Tunisia and Iran might set up a joint chamber of trade to boost cooperation.
- A Mediterranean meeting on reinforcing cooperation between small and medium firms to be held in Tunis on September 24-26.
